events.title: Demo Update #4 - Farms, Seeds, Pots and reworked Challenges
events.summary: Hi there! A pretty substantial update this time, including some reworks, bug fixes, and new content. Here's most of the good stuff:ChallengesThe whole Quest system has been removed, and Challenges now act as the actual Quests. You unlock them just as before - by winning a level once.Challenges are now harder overall.VikingsVikings now drop considerably less loot. Most Vikings drop loot and one other item.Bolt Vikings have been renamed and reskinned as Iron Vikings to fit the new relationship bet

events.title: Demo Update - Bug Fixes, Tutorial, Extra Stats
events.summary: Hey everyone!Here are a few more improvements in this update:Added a dedicated tutorial levelAdded an inspect panel that appears when clicking on SubjectsFixed several bugs, mainly related to how Subjects fetch tasksAdjusted some item values for better balanceIMPORTANT: If you have an ongoing run, playing the tutorial will require you to wipe your current level progress.Thanks to everyone who's been playing the demo and sharing feedback!Have fun!
